name: Mariana Alves de Souza
title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
summary: Senior digital marketing leader with 10+ years of experience driving demand generation, performance media, CRM, and brand growth across B2B and B2C markets. Known for building data-driven campaigns, improving ROI, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable revenue impact.

bullets: Led a 12-person growth team and increased qualified leads by 68% within 18 months through paid media, landing page optimization, and CRM nurturing.
Reduced cost per acquisition by 31% while scaling monthly media spend from R$180K to R$420K across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.
Implemented GA4 and Looker Studio dashboards, improving executive reporting cadence and enabling weekly budget reallocation decisions.
Partnered with sales to align funnel SLAs, contributing to a 22% improvement in lead-to-opportunity conversion rate.
Managed omnichannel acquisition campaigns for e-commerce and retail initiatives, driving a 54% increase in online revenue year over year.
Improved ROAS by 27% by restructuring account architecture, refining audience segmentation, and testing new creative formats.
Launched lifecycle email and SMS journeys that lifted repeat purchase rate by 19% and reduced churn in loyalty programs.
Supervised agency partners and internal stakeholders to deliver integrated campaigns across media, content, and promotions.
Built paid search and social acquisition programs that increased student enrollments by 41% across undergraduate and postgraduate products.
Lowered lead acquisition costs by 24% through keyword optimization, cohort analysis, and conversion rate testing.
Created reporting standards for campaign performance and funnel attribution, improving budget efficiency during peak enrollment periods.
Mentored junior analysts and coordinated with admissions teams to improve speed-to-lead and contact rates.
Executed PPC, SEO, and content support for clients in education, healthcare, and consumer goods, managing up to 18 accounts simultaneously.
Produced monthly performance reports and insights that helped retain 90% of key clients year over year.
Supported website optimization projects that increased organic traffic by an average of 33% for top-tier accounts.
Collaborated with designers and copywriters to improve ad relevance and landing page conversion performance.
